rows.basis: Growth in gross AI GPUs PP&E: 42,573,000 − 39,324,000 = 3,249,000, against 202,928,000 of purchases of property and equipment. It excludes River Bend construction, which may sit in construction in progress or land; neither category is AI-specific, and the pack does not split them. It also excludes Data center infrastructure (Traditional Cloud), mining categories and the 162.7m of deposits for future sites.

Hut 8 says it will develop at least 245 MW and up to 2,295 MW of AI data center infrastructure under the Anthropic/Fluidstack partnership, built with Jacobs and Vertiv at $9-11m per MW. No total capex is stated. 245 MW × $9-11m (about $2.2-2.7bn) is a reader's calculation, not an amount.

MD&A: a $1.0m increase in cost of revenue for the AI Cloud offering, which launched in September 2024. With no prior-year cost, this is the FY2024 AI Cloud cost. GPU depreciation is excluded. The pack has no FY2024 opex value, so there is no share.

MD&A: AI Cloud costs rose $2.2m on a full year of activity, and depreciation of AI GPUs rose $6.6m. Together with the FY2024 $1.0m this implies about $3.2m of AI Cloud cost of revenue plus GPU depreciation. That is a reader's calculation; no FY2025 amount is stated.

MD&A: a $1.8m contribution from the AI Cloud (GPU-as-a-Service, Highrise AI) offering launched in September 2024, against 162,385,000 of total revenue. It excludes Traditional/Data Center Cloud, which is legacy Canadian colocation and not AI, and the quarterly 'HPC – Colocation and Cloud' figures that mix the two. The Compute segment mixes mining and AI cloud and is not used.

MD&A: AI Cloud revenue rose $7.4m on a full year of sales. 1.8m + 7.4m ≈ 9.2m is a reader's calculation, not a stated amount. AI Cloud sits inside the Compute segment (202.3m), which also holds ASIC mining and has no split.
A Q1 2024 release expected revenue to begin in the second half of the year at a forecast annual rate of about $20m. This is a run-rate, not a fiscal-year figure.

A Q1 2026 release cites a $16.8bn contracted revenue base from triple-net leases for 597 MW across two hyperscale AI campuses, including the River Bend Fluidstack lease. This is total contract value over the lease terms, not revenue in any year.
